features: THE NUMBER NOBODY HAD ASKED THE SERVER FOR — No migration: the database is not touched. Beta.58 came from a precise report («a 4376 KB file does not go through, and it says Max 10MB above it») and closed it where it had been made. That measurement found six more identical doors: this version closes them all and adds what stops a seventh from being born.

TEN DOORS, EACH WITH ITS OWN SERVER'S LIMIT. Every point where a file is uploaded now asks the server how much it can take, instead of announcing a number we decided. There are ten: archive documents, the user area's, suppliers', an invoice attachment, the print signature and the importer.

THAT DOES NOT MEAN THEY ARE ALL THE SAME NOW, and this is the part that matters: each door keeps the ceiling that makes sense for it — 20 MB for a document, 10 for an invoice attachment, 2 for a signature, 25 for the importer, which receives a whole program's export. What changed is that none promises more than the machine will actually take. On hosting that stops at 2 MB, all ten say 2 MB.

THE IMPORTER WAS THE WORST CASE, and nobody had reported it: it announced 25 MB to everyone, including those who had two. It is the channel through which a whole building is brought in — exactly the moment when discovering a limit afterwards costs most.

«20480 KILOBYTES». The other half of the forum report was the error message, and it had stayed open until now. When a file exceeds our limit the program said «the file cannot be larger than 20480 kilobytes»: the right number, in a unit nobody uses and different from the one the screen next to it had just written. Now it says «20 MB», and it says the same number as the screen.

WHAT THE SCREENS OFFERED AND THE PROGRAM REFUSED. Four screens let you pick JPG and PNG images while the program only accepts PDF: you chose the file, waited for the upload, and watched it be rejected. The list of formats is now the same on both sides.

THE SAME ON THE PRINT SIGNATURE, where two defects lived together: the picker also offered vector files — which the rule has always refused — and under the field, instead of the help text, the technical name of the missing translation appeared. An Italian administrator was reading «impostazioni.label.print_signature_help» printed on the page.

THE MUNICIPALITY LIST, WHICH CAN NOW REALLY BE UPDATED. Beta.59 brought the ISTAT list into the program and promised anyone in a hurry they could update it themselves. They could not: the command only accepted the format we had already converted, and the recipe for converting it was written nowhere. It now reads the file as ISTAT publishes it, and one command is enough: «php artisan kondomanager:aggiorna-comuni --da=Elenco-comuni-italiani.xlsx». It costs 74 MB of memory and two seconds, and works even on the tightest hosting — tested at 128 MB, the typical shared-hosting limit.

AND THERE IS A WAY TO KNOW WHEN IT IS WORTH DOING: «php artisan kondomanager:verifica-fonte-comuni» asks ISTAT and compares with the list in use. It does not run on its own and never will: the list travels inside the program precisely so that no installation depends on a connection. You run it when you want — in January, when municipality mergers take legal effect.

THE TRANSLATION'S TECHNICAL NAME INSTEAD OF THE WORD. On about twenty screens the path at the top of the page showed something like «IMPOSTAZIONI.LABEL.SETTINGS › IMPOSTAZIONI.DIALOGS.PRINT_SETTINGS_TITLE» instead of «Settings › PDF print settings»: it happened on the create and edit screens for buildings, contacts, suppliers, documents, announcements and issues. Translations reach the program shortly after the page does, and those texts were written once, too early. They now rewrite themselves when the translations arrive. Along with this, a hundred fallbacks that never worked were removed: lines written to show a spare text when a translation is missing, which never came into play.
THE REST. The number of bilingual municipalities announced in the previous version was wrong: 121, not 124. The old number counted a different column from the one the program uses to search them.
